image_description: A medium shot of a man wearing a blue cap and dark jacket operating a bandsaw in a woodworking shop. He is guiding a rough log through the saw blade. In the foreground, there are stacks of cut lumber and wood scraps. The background features large windows looking out onto green trees, suggesting a rural or semi-industrial setting. The structure appears to be a timber-frame building with glass walls.
